build_table_cells: build table cells from HTML sequence, OTSL sequence, bounding boxes, and cell classes
match_cells: match table cells to PDF page cells using IOU threshold and return matching details
translate_bboxes: translate normalized table cell bounding boxes to page coordinate system with y-flip
find_intersection: compute the intersection bounding box between two page-coordinate bboxes
validate_bboxes_page: validate that a list of bounding boxes have positive area in page coordinates
